impact: Fixed-name staging files are created BEFORE assertHeld() (only the rename is gated), so test obligation 6's zero-mutation claim is false: a revoked-authority invocation still creates the fixed staging file, which then blocks the legitimate successor with EEXIST after its sweep; ungated cleanup can also delete a successor's file at the same fixed path (ABA). Fix: verify authority BEFORE the startup sweep; assertHeld() immediately before every staging creation, every staging cleanup, and every rename; after observed authority loss LEAVE residue and report it, never delete. Transfer-interleaving test proves a stale invocation can neither create, rename, nor remove the successor's staging file.
